slides.title: Vet clinic managers: 5 dates you can't let lapse
Every vet's and tech's license
slides.body: Different people, different renewal dates, one very bad surprise.

slides.title: DEA registration
slides.body: Lapse it and the controlled drugs cabinet stays shut.

slides.title: X-ray registration, permits and insurance
slides.body: Each one renews on its own schedule. None of them send flowers.

slides.title: Save this for renewal season
slides.body: Then put all five dates somewhere that reminds you before they expire.
